name: cmd
tagline: A reimplementation of Windows cmd.exe for Unix
description: cmd is a C reimplementation of Windows cmd.exe that runs on Unix, built for cross-platform batch script testing. It targets the batch-language surface that CI systems and Windows-first tooling depend on, so batch scripts can be exercised on Linux and macOS without a Windows box. The project is early but genuinely useful for anyone maintaining cross-platform pipelines that still ship .bat files.
highlights: Reimplements Windows cmd.exe behavior in C for Unix
Lets batch scripts run and be tested on Linux and macOS
Targets the batch-language surface CI systems rely on
Cross-platform testing without spinning up a Windows VM
curatorNote: Batch files are the least loved part of cross-platform engineering, but they refuse to die. A C reimplementation of cmd.exe that runs on Unix is the pragmatic answer for CI systems that still have to test .bat scripts.
